title: TextualRL: Textual Reinforcement Learning for Context Management
abstract: arXiv:2610.18216v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents can adapt to task feedback by revising the textual context that guides their behavior, without changing their model parameters. However, turning execution rewards into reusable context updates is challenging: individual trajectories offer limited comparative evidence about what to change, while task-specific fixes may overgeneralize when incorporated into a shared context. We introduce TextualRL, a gradient-free reinforcement learning framework that treats a group of rollouts from the same task under the same context, rather than an isolated trajectory, as the unit of policy critique. Groupwise Policy Critique contrasts successful and failed rollouts within a task; when outcomes are uniform, it draws on cross-task evidence to identify behaviors worth preserving or formulate repair hypotheses. translated_title: TextualRL：面向上下文管理的文本强化学习
translated_abstract: LLM 智能体可以通过修改引导其行为的文本上下文来适应任务反馈，而无需改变模型参数。然而，如何将执行奖励转化为可复用的上下文更新是一个挑战：单个轨迹为“该改什么”所能提供的对比证据有限，而针对特定任务的修复方案在被纳入共享上下文时又可能过度泛化。我们提出了 TextualRL，一个无梯度的强化学习框架，它以在相同上下文下执行的同一任务的一组 rollout（而非孤立的轨迹）作为策略评判的单位。组级策略评判在任务内部对比成功与失败的 rollout；当结果一致时，它会借助跨任务证据来识别值得保留的行为，或形成修复假设。跨组策略更新则根据跨组汇总的证据（包括未能产生……的观察结果）来审查由此产生的改进提案。
tldr: 提出 TextualRL 框架，以“同任务同上下文下的一组 rollout”取代单条轨迹作为策略评判单位，通过组内成功/失败对比与跨组证据聚合，实现无梯度、可复用的上下文自动改进。
en_tdlr: TextualRL is a gradient-free reinforcement learning framework that uses groups of rollouts from the same task—rather than isolated trajectories—as the unit of policy critique, enabling reusable context updates via groupwise contrastive critique and cross-group evidence aggregation.
